name: ce.debug_events
description: Page recorded debugger events for the current target generation. Events do not prove a sustained native stop; repeated hits were observed while reported paused. Cursor continuity under rolling-buffer rollover is unverified and events may be missed. Do not infer safe stepping or a complete execution history from successful pages.

cursor.description: Use nextCursor for paging, but continuity under rolling-buffer rollover is unverified; a page sequence may miss events.
